title: A Systematic Review on the Visualization of Avatars and Agents in AR & VR displayed using Head-Mounted Displays
venue: IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics
scope: avatar and agent visualization in HMD AR/VR
key_methodological_value: compares visible body parts, rendering styles, objective/subjective measures, and task domains
key_limit_for_our_project: domain-specific and includes AR; does not provide field-wide algorithm/evidence/reproducibility map

title: Questionnaires for evaluating virtual reality: A systematic scoping review
key_methodological_value: maps constructs and psychometric evidence; exposes measurement heterogeneity

title: Security and privacy in virtual reality: a literature survey
scope: VR privacy, security, authentication and cybersecurity uses
key_methodological_value: detailed threat/privacy taxonomy and authentication emphasis
key_limit_for_our_project: not designed as a complete systematic field review; security/privacy only

title: Immersive virtual reality in higher education: a systematic review of the scientific literature
key_methodological_value: reports lack of standardized design, repeated comparative validation, and contradictory outcomes
key_limit_for_our_project: education-specific; does not establish field-wide technical gaps

title: Confounded or Controlled? A Systematic Review of Media Comparison Studies Involving Immersive Virtual Reality for STEM Education
scope: controlled IVR media comparisons in STEM education
key_methodological_value: demonstrates need to audit comparison confounding; only 26% fully controlled on five criteria

title: Virtual reality research status: a scientometric analysis based on CNKI and WOS
scope: macro-level VR research status and trends
corpus_or_search_size: 4673 CNKI and 36450 WoS records; WoS period 2000-2024
key_methodological_value: large-scale field map useful for terminology, temporal trends, and corpus calibration
key_limit_for_our_project: bibliometric/co-word structure cannot establish claim validity or algorithmic gaps

title: Visual quality features in immersive virtual environments: a systematic review of their impact on user experience
key_methodological_value: decomposes visual quality into modelling, hardware/rendering, and motion/interaction

title: The Effectiveness of Immersive Virtual Reality-Based Treatment for Mental Disorders: A Systematic Review With Meta-Analysis
scope: immersive VR interventions for mental disorders
corpus_or_search_size: 2443 records screened; final meta-analytic corpus to verify in full extraction
key_methodological_value: provides health-domain quantitative synthesis precedent
key_limit_for_our_project: clinical-domain-specific and not a technical benchmark review

title: A Review of Virtual Reality Studies on Autonomous Vehicle–Pedestrian Interaction
key_methodological_value: example of systematic analysis of scenarios, behavioral factors, and evaluation measures

title: The aftereffects of virtual reality: a narrative review
scope: post-VR negative impacts including cybersickness and aftereffects
key_methodological_value: extends human-factor scope beyond exposure-period cybersickness
key_limit_for_our_project: not systematic enough to establish prevalence or completeness alone

title: Haptic Feedback in Virtual Reality: A Systematic Review and Tutorial for Practitioners
key_methodological_value: unified H-VR view across application fields and evaluation factors

scope: mediated social touch with avatars and agents
key_methodological_value: organizes context, technology, data and outcomes

title: Sicknificant Steps: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of VR Sickness in Walking-based Locomotion for Virtual Reality
key_methodological_value: quantitative sickness comparison across walking/redirection classes

title: Haptic virtual reality for the blind and visually impaired: a taxonomy and a comprehensive literature review
scope: haptic VR accessibility for blind and visually impaired users

title: Social virtual reality: systematic review of virtual teamwork with head-mounted displays

key_methodological_value: connects generative models, hardware, psychology and ethics

title: Virtual humans in virtual reality: a scoping review on sociability, fidelity, and expression

title: Is modularity the future of haptics in XR? A systematic literature review
key_methodological_value: maps modularity as a haptic design dimension

venue: IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics
key_methodological_value: covers experiment lifecycle and identifies interoperability, timing, durable-export and replay needs
